reason: Pangaea is an ocean dry bulk shipper (owned and chartered ice-class vessels, contracts of affreightment) that serves commodity producers and traders. Proficient is a North American trucking carrier that hauls finished vehicles from plants, ports and rail ramps to dealerships for automakers. Both are asset-based freight service providers. But the transport mode, cargo and buyers are all different, and the only link is the general "logistics" label.
